messages:
jordan (support): customer reported Token Billing Insights showing $0 or NaN for a subset of orgs (orgs: org-312, org-887). Happening since ~02:15 UTC. They see correct usage but zeros in token-cost column. attaching screenshots.
kevin (eng-analytics): thanks — can you paste an example trace id or org id? any request ids from the dashboard?
jordan (support): sent a quick list: org-312, org-887. sample request_id: rq_02b8f9a1. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/test-screens/zeroes.png
sara (billing): are these orgs on consolidated billing or do they have delegated billing? might affect ledger join.
jordan (support): org-312 = delegated billing, org-887 = standalone. both hit $0 / NaN.
kevin (eng-analytics): OK looking at the metrics pipeline — there's a daily aggregation job (agg_token_costs) that writes to billing_ledger. I see a failure window around 02:12-02:20 UTC. error: 'ForeignKeyViolation: metrics_service.batch_metrics -> billing_ledger(ledger_id)' in job logs.
tara (eng-sre): deploy-bot noted a rollout at 02:05 UTC to analytics-service v3.4.8 — maybe a schema drift. deploy-bot: "deploy analytics-service v3.4.8 to prod by @kevin at 02:05 UTC"
kevin (eng-analytics): yep we deployed a change that tightened the ledger FK. Looks like some aggregated rows lacked ledger_id when pipeline consumed events from Kafka 02:10-02:15. those rows got dropped, leaving zeroed entries when dashboards join by org.
sara (billing): is the drop producing NaN in the frontend or are we inserting 0s in ledger?
kevin (eng-analytics): join behavior: left join metrics -> ledger. when ledger missing, frontend calculation does division and ends up NaN for per-token cost, and $0 for total_cost in some aggregations.
jordan (support): customer asked for repro steps + ETA. can we give mitigation?
tara (eng-sre): short-term mitigation: run backfill job to reprocess Kafka window 02:05-02:25 for affected partitions. I can spin up the backfill container. Command: 
```
python tools/backfill.py --topic metrics-events --start 2026-03-11T02:05:00Z --end 2026-03-11T02:25:00Z --partitions 3
```
I'll also temporarily flip feature-flag "ledger-strict-fk" -> off to allow rows to ingest while we backfill.
sara (billing): if backfill completes, will we correct dashboards retroactively? we need to update any cached tiles.
kevin (eng-analytics): yes backfill repopulates billing_ledger, then run the re-aggregate job: 
```
python infra/run_agg.py --job agg_token_costs --window 2026-03-11
```
Then purge CDN cache for /billing/insights/* (ops-bot can do).
ops-bot: Purge request queued: /billing/insights/* (id: purge_8992).
jordan (support): ETA for backfill + re-agg? customer needs a timeline.
tara (eng-sre): starting backfill now (tracking id backfill-17542). estimate 30-45m for backfill + 10m for agg + 5-10m for cache purge. escalated to incident if still not resolved by 03:30 UTC.
kevin (eng-analytics): root cause: schema-enforcement change in v3.4.8 without a compensating mapper for legacy events. follow-up actions: 1) revert strict FK or codify permissive ingest, 2) add guardrail tests for schema compatibility, 3) add pipeline alert on aggregate drop-rate > 0.5%.
sara (billing): I'll notify affected customers and confirm refunds/adjustments policy once metrics are restored.
jordan (support): noted — I'll update the customer with the ETA and provide the tracking id. thanks team :thumbsup:
kevin (eng-analytics): after backfill completes I'll post a short summary and the commit that fixes the mapper.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0311-07 linked to backfill-17542.
tara (eng-sre): closing loop: if anyone sees additional orgs with NaN/0 after re-agg, ping me directly and include org id + sample request id.
